hardware.notes: PicoCalc MusicPlayer UF2 #3 evidence. Board revision and SD identification are not recorded yet. The canonical BSP tree is committed at repository_commit above; the tested UF2 was built before that commit and its boot line reported bsp_git=untracked, so this provenance limitation is retained explicitly.

lcd.observed: The evidence log contains three boots. Boots 1 and 3 passed the five RGB565 solid-color readbacks and known 2x2 pattern; boot 2 failed after its first readback, returning 0x0000 for the remaining patterns while display tile timing remained normal. The RAMRD/readback cause is unresolved. Product drawing does not use RAMRD, but the BSP readback acceptance criterion is intermittent.

sd.observed: The complete third boot passed filesystem smoke, nested directory enumeration, full MP3 read, and MIDI read. No formatting or destructive SD preparation was performed.

keyboard.observed: The complete third boot passed early and late input probes. Up 0xb5, Down 0xb6, Enter 0x0a, and Escape 0xb1 each had pressed=1 and released=1; status_fail=0, invalid_states=0, and unexpected_events=0. Earlier missed-key attempts remain in the evidence log.

notes: Additional app evidence is kept in the MusicPlayer project TEST_REPORT. The same log records PSRAM 8MiB self-test pass, 1kHz PCM stream for 3s with underrun=0/clip=0/drop=0, Helix silent decode timing, and MIDI parsing; these are intentionally not added as BSP test keys. Tested app was 0.2.0-helix-uf2-3 with build timestamp 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z. Evidence log SHA-256=4a24859689214d1536d6ba98898be85ff080881c528abc26840f811cb75d321b. The record remains pending because board/SD identity is missing and LCD readback is intermittent.
